name: GeoCorpus Schema
description: A schema for geographically grounded Earth-science corpus units.

fields.text_type: definition / method / result / caption / qa_answer / interpretation
fields.domain: cryosphere / hydrology / meteorology / climatology / geomorphology / ecosystem / human_activity / hazard_risk
fields.geo_object_type: glacier / grid / region / station / basin / event / raster_layer
fields.geo_object_id: Specific object ID, such as glacier_id, region_id, grid_id, station_id

fields.evidence_type: statistic / raster / vector / crosswalk / method / figure / literature
fields.source_table: Table or file where evidence comes from
fields.source_id: Object ID or row ID in source table
fields.statistic: mean / median / trend / p10 / p90 / cv / area / count

fields.question: Question text
fields.answer_rule: How the answer should be generated

fields.data_type: GeoObject / GeoField / GeoRegion / GeoEvent / GeoRelation / indicator

fields.temporal_support: static / yearly / monthly / daily / event / period
fields.aggregation_rule: mean / sum / area_weighted_mean / majority / max / percentile
